reviews.text: Good!
The guys who help the doctor are very kind to the animals; a very good experience.
Super

What an amazing experience! Our 4 year old pup ate a toy and had an obstruction. Dr. Viamonte worked with his amazing team, Erick, Lazaro, Anita, Dora, and Carlos (there are more but these were the ones I recalled), they worked hand in hand to provide amazing care for Arya. During the surgery they kept me updated, after and while she was boarded! I am so lucky to have found such an amazing clinic for my pup. Dr. Viamonte and Erick specifically, made this experience calm and reassuring. I recommend this clinic to anyone that has an animal!

The staff were helpful and attentive. Their calm demeanor helped my fiesty chihuahua to calm down. Dr. Viamonte was very informative about my questions and concerns. Overall, I left feeling better about my chihuahua’s health.
Triple check your bill. They will try to double the price of the service if you don't check.
I just brought my dog to the Dr. VIAMONTE. they are so knowledgeable and so nice and so humane.I'm very happy that he is my veterinarian and his staff is wonderful and his vet technicians are amazing
I loveeeeeeee this clinic. They are so sweet and they really love animals. I’ve been coming here for 5 years now. I trust them with my cat, Alice
Very grateful for how professional they are ❤️❤️❤️
A friend recommended them as we were shopping for a new broader moving to this area. They are great! The vet and his staff are so attentive and our dogs feel very comfortable with them.

Amazing staff and care! Everyone is always super friendly and knowledgeable. I’ve been going for years and I wouldn’t trust anyone else with my cat. Dr. Viamonte and the entire staff take the time to make sure your pet is cared for and are super transparent about testament options and finances. Special shout out to Shelsy who is incredibly kind and reassuring, she always makes certain that my questions are all answered thoroughly!
Excellent service!!! And attentive at all times. Very professional.

The medical care itself was appropriate and handled professionally, and I appreciate the staff’s responsiveness during urgent visits.
Especially the trainees did a great job caring for my dog — their communication was excellent, the veterinary care was thorough, and they clearly explained the costs upfront.

That said, I was surprised by the level of add-on items presented after an initial treatment plan had already been reviewed and accepted. Several non-essential products and services were offered repeatedly (such as food, probiotics, and other extras), which made the visit feel more sales-driven than expected.

I also want to note that this is not the first time I’ve experienced this here. In previous visits, additional charges were added under stressful circumstances that I did not notice at the time — including a relatively high fee for a “special shampoo,” and small but unapproved items such as brief ear cleaning performed without prior discussion and then added to the bill.

I would strongly encourage clearer upfront communication and explicit consent before adding optional services or products. This would go a long way toward building trust, especially during stressful or emergency situations.

I have been taking my dogs there for a few years now. Dr. Viamonte and his team are exceptional. They are highly skilled at what they do but the love and care they have for animals is palpable. They always take the time to answer my questions and explain things in a clear and concise manner. Highly recommend!
Caring and efficient.
I bring my cat here because of the level of care they have for the animals. You can tell Viamonte truly loves and cares for your pet.

I am incredibly grateful for this vet and the care he provided to my cat. Excellent veterinarian with outstanding knowledge and dedication. He took the time to thoroughly evaluate my cat and explain everything clearly. His passion for animal care truly stands out, and it shows in the way he treats both pets and owners. I felt reassured knowing my cat was in such capable and caring hands. Highly recommend this vet to anyone looking for high-quality, compassionate care. My cat was treated with patience, kindness, and respect.

Viamonte Veterinary Clinic has provided exceptional care to my dog for many years, and once again they went above and beyond during a recent emergency with a cat we rescued from the street after a motor vehicle accident.

From the moment we arrived, the level of professionalism, clinical expertise, and genuine compassion was outstanding. Dr. Juan Viamonte exemplifies what it means to be an excellent veterinarian (thorough, knowledgeable, calm, and deeply kind). He took the time to explain every step of the evaluation and treatment, while making sure the animal was comfortable and that we felt supported during a very stressful situation.

The entire staff deserves recognition as well. Their kindness, empathy, and dedication were evident in every interaction. They treated this injured stray with the same care and respect they would give to a longtime patient, which speaks volumes about their values and commitment to animal welfare.

Viamonte Veterinary Clinic consistently combines top-tier medical care with humanity and compassion. I am incredibly grateful to Dr. Viamonte and his team and would recommend this clinic without hesitation to anyone looking for exceptional veterinary care.

This went from privately owned to private equity sponsored and the whole place changed.  Now they try to sell you everything under the sun including vitamins for my dying dog who lasted a week after his last visit.  I have had it with this business and will not be going back. You have been warned

I have been coming to this veterinary office for some time and I truly love the veterinarians and staff. They consistently treat my cat with genuine care, take the time to address my concerns, and overall provide excellent medical service.

That said, I’ve now used the in-house groomer twice, and my most recent experience was disappointing. During my cat’s second grooming appointment, I was informed that she needed to be sedated. While I did consent, I was upset that a professional groomer did not have the tools or skill set to groom my friendly, well-behaved cat without sedation.

Additionally, I requested a medium trim, which is what my cat has received in the past. Unfortunately, her coat was cut extremely short—almost shaved—during one of the coldest times of the year. Because of this, she has been noticeably uncomfortable and has spent most of her time bundled under blankets instead of being her usual social, playful self.

Lastly, while she was clean, she did not have the fresh scent or finishing touches (such as the light perfume) that she received during her previous grooming visit.

I continue to highly recommend this veterinary practice for their medical care and compassionate staff, but I hope this feedback helps improve the grooming experience moving forward.
Excellent service.

I visited this veterinary clinic as a customer and was extremely disappointed by the unprofessional behavior I witnessed. While the front desk staff were very kind and welcoming, the treatment they received from what appeared to be the owner was shocking. She entered the clinic loudly demanding to know who parked in “her” spot, and when one of the employees politely explained that she had to park across the street and walk, the owner didn’t even acknowledge her and responded dismissively.

Shortly after, the doctor arrived and walked past his own staff without so much as a greeting or acknowledgment. The overall atmosphere felt tense, disrespectful, and disorganized.

Although the employees were doing their best, the leadership and environment made the experience extremely uncomfortable. Based on what I observed, I would not recommend this clinic.

At Viamonte Veterinary Clinic, I've found a place that makes it easy to treat my four pets, two of whom have chronic health issues: my golden retriever's allergies and recurring ear infections. My 11-year-old chihuahua has a heart murmur that the vet identified almost a year ago, and thanks to treatment and a special diet, he's been very stable. He's even managed to lose the extra weight that made it so difficult for him to do simple daily activities like walking. I highly recommend this place, and as an added bonus, the office is always spotless.
Excellent, very professional, friendly and helpful. The doctor shows great love and sensitivity for pets, has extensive experience, and creates a pleasant atmosphere.

Best Veterinarian in town!
They care for your pet and have patience. The Doctor is thorough and compassionate. Love them

Sadly, at that place they don't care about your pet, only about the money they can get out of you. There's a lot of disorganization, and the doctor tries to do too much at once, so you end up being treated by his assistants. The doctor barely glances at your pet and leaves. The assistants do everything, but they do a half-hearted job. They draw blood for lab work and don't close or disinfect the puncture wound they make in your pet, leaving the poor dog bleeding out. They leave the samples scattered all over the office because they have to attend to 10
other pets who have been waiting for more than two hours to get in. There's no parking, and the place is tiny and infuriating. There's a huge lack of respect and consideration for pets and their owners. All they care about there is the money they can squeeze out of you.
Excellent service, they love what they do. I'm very happy because they've taken great care of my baby Colita. I highly recommend them; they treat your pets well.

Terrible service. They don't follow good practices, the staff and the veterinarian lack training. I recommend they improve their service and continue their studies. I had my cat there for two weeks for mild constipation, which they turned into an emergency appointment. They stressed him so much that the intestinal blockage became a matter of life or death. All they did was tell me they didn't know what to do and that I should take my cat somewhere else. They charged me $1700, and after already charging me $1700, I had to rush to another clinic. Veterinarian Viamonte never faced me or gave me an explanation; he always sends his supposed assistants to speak for him! That veterinary clinic shouldn't be operating... terrible service... Where are the results of the initial ultrasounds they supposedly used to treat my cat? Why didn't they send me the results as promised?
My pet received professional care. Everyone was very attentive and helpful.
Love this place

I love this office! I take both of my cats here for their checkups and they have always been very professional and caring, shoutout to Carlos and Ana for their gentleness. Shelsy at the front is just the sweetest, she always makes sure all our financials are handled and we leave with no questions unanswered.

My experience with Dr. Viamonte’s veterinary office was extremely disappointing and unprofessional. On September 4th, I paid over $500 for my dog Bella’s USDA travel paperwork for our trip to Spain on September 20th, including an additional fee to expedite the process. Despite repeated calls and assurances from the staff that everything was handled, the paperwork did not arrive on time.

After multiple follow-ups, I learned that the USDA had returned the paperwork three separate times because it was completed incorrectly. I was never able to speak directly with Dr. Viamonte, nor did I receive an apology or explanation. As a result, I had to reschedule my flight, shorten my three-week trip to ten days, and incur significant financial losses.

For a veterinarian who claims to be an experienced traveler, this level of carelessness and lack of communication is unacceptable. His prices are excessive, and he often pushes unnecessary products and medications.

I would strongly caution anyone considering this clinic—there are far more competent and professional veterinarians elsewhere.
An excellent team, great service, and splendid dedication to the pets. Greetings and thanks to all.
Excellent service, very professional in their work

I want to say a huge thanks to Dr. Viamonte and his team for their dedication for animals. I brought in a stray cat for a spay from North Miami and even though they were super busy and overbooked, they took care of her to make sure she was safe and I didn’t have to come back twice. You can see the love here. We arrived at 8:45 AM and there was a line out the door. Great doctor and great team. Definitely recommend and a huge thank you again.
Very good clinic, I recommend it.

Horrible experience. They give me a price i drive 1½hr to get to this place only for them to jack up the price 140dollars more than original price they do a bait and switch on you. I don't recomend this place. They can't even honor the price that I was given. The sad part is this was one of the more expensive quotes we received.
They always have what my furry friend needs 🐶 …
Dr. Viamonte is an excellent professional, and so is his entire team! We are very happy with their care.

If I could give 1000 stars or 1 million,
I would! Truly, the service from the entire staff was exemplary.
I arrived desperate because my kitten was exhibiting aggressive and strange behavior, and with the care of Erick, Carlos, Dani, Ana, and Samy, my cat recovered spectacularly. Two weeks later, I returned, and Samantha and Erick greeted me warmly. They examined her, and I couldn't be more grateful.
Thank you so much! I'm incredibly grateful and highly recommended!

Excellent service. This is my second time visiting. First, I rescued a kitten from the street who was nearly dead. He was treated, had surgery, and recovered. Now he has a loving home with a family who adopted him. Today, I went with my cat, Suka. Everyone was wonderful, from the receptionist to the doctor, Eric (who appears in the video), and another young man who treated our pets the way we like. I left very happy and highly recommend them. Thank you so much!
Great service, knowledgeable staff. Owner almost always on site. Love it here and come all the way from Miramar because of the service.
Very nice employees. and very cute spot! The dog I babysit is also very healthy and this is his doctor. The owner is very happy!
Excellent

I was not pleased with the care my friend's dog received. I accompanied her and was shocked by the poor practices, which I won't describe here.
A little more care, empathy, and professionalism would do them a world of good. I don't recommend this place. I don't believe an animal's health is truly safe there.
They are the best. Everyone there is amazing, plus the services are excellent. I trust them with my 6 babies.
Friendly knowledge staff. Vet is caring and professional. My cat is happy with them.
Thank you for the 5-star rating, Hugo! We appreciate your support and look forward to serving you again.
Everyone at Viamonte is the best! From the doctor to his staff. My dog loves going to see his vet.
I love it, the team is super professional and caring with pets

The best veterinarian in Miami! Dr. Viamonte has been my dogs vet since she was 6 months old and now my dog is 3 years old. I highly recommend this veterinary, he is highly knowledgeable and cares about the wellness of your pets. A+
Very human with the sadness of putting my beloved kittens to sleep, but I was able to be with them until their last breath
Viamonte has been my dog’s primary vet for years. They are not only informative when they come back with results but very compassionate and loving towards my Francesca. Also Erick is amazing!
